scope: Independent reference and native-distance review, Blender only
observations: The box chamfer, plug, front screws and ribbed underside match the reference construction. Night review lighting now reveals worn steel; maps remain unchanged and neutral. The elevated RTS camera sees the top of the housing and occludes the downward-facing diffuser; 150/450 m elevated views therefore do not show a bright indicator. The reference-angle blue/red/green views demonstrate the actual emitting face.
changes: Retained the chamfered worn-steel box, slotted end plug, two front screws and recessed ribbed underside diffuser. Increased only night review lighting for readable steel. BaseColor and LightProfile are exactly achromatic; colour variants change emission tint only.
limits: The underside lens is physically hidden from the elevated RTS test camera. No artificial upper emitting surface was added. The product-angle tint views, not the top view, establish optical appearance.
